|gr1= AI Behaviour

|descr= Sets skill of given unit. Unlike [[setSkill]], [[setUnitAbility]] can set values > 1. Even though the [[skill]] command will correctly return set value, the actual unit ability will be capped to max available.

|s1= unit [[setUnitAbility]] value

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|p2= value: [[Number]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>_unit setUnitAbility 1;</sqf>
|x2= <sqf>
bob setUnitAbility -log 0;
hint str skill bob; //1.#INF
</sqf>

|seealso= [[skill]] [[setSkill]] [[CfgAISkill]] [[Combat Modes]]
